text: {"lessons":["Doing nothing avoided reactive trades, but it also left my portfolio exposed to the full market swings; I should review whether my overall risk still suits me.","A rising account can quickly give back gains, so I should not mistake recent performance for a reliable forecast.","I should make occasional, deliberate portfolio reviews and base any trades on diversification, risk, and future prospects—not on short-term price moves or purchase-price break-even."]}
